# 1e: Apple Music module and shelf-wrapper

## Read first

- [sources/apple-music.md](../sources/apple-music.md), [architecture.md](../architecture.md), [deployment.md](../deployment.md) section Images.
- The As built section of [1b](1b.md).
- For reference only, without copying code: `~/projects/apple-music-downloader/internal/amp-api/*.go`, `internal/app/run.go`, `internal/app/url.go`, `config.yaml.example`.
- `~/projects/wrapper` on the `lite` branch: `lite/lite_main.cpp` for the flags and service mode, `lite/auth.cpp` for the 2FA file, `wrapper-lite-rootless.c` for signals, and the `Dockerfile`.

## Done when

- `internal/modules/applemusic` implements `Source`, `LinkParser`, `Searcher`, `Resolver` and `Downloader`, and is enabled when `SHELF_AMDL_CONFIG` points at a readable file.
- The catalog client, the amdl config renderer and the amdl runner pass their tests against fixtures and a fake `amdl` script.
- `cmd/shelf-wrapper` and the `wrapper` Dockerfile target exist; the supervisor passes its tests against a fake launcher script.
- `/api/applemusic/wrapper` and its `login`, `code` and `restart` routes pass the requests to the supervisor.
- CI pushes `shelf-wrapper` next to `shelf`.
- On blackberry, a staging run downloaded one real album through shelf. Its amdl output and the live artist-view answers are saved as fixtures.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Code origin | Written from scratch against the requests listed in sources/apple-music.md. | amdl has no licence. |
| Token | Regex for `/assets/index~[^/]+\.js` on the page, then `eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+` in the script. Cached until `exp` minus 10 minutes. | The web player's token, as amdl gets it. |
| Retries | A 401 scrapes the token again and retries once. A 429 waits for `Retry-After`, or 2, 4, then 8 seconds, then fails. | Bounded retries. |
| Storefront | The first entry of `regions` from `GET <SHELF_WRAPPER_URL>/status`, cached for 10 minutes, falling back to `general.storefront`. | The account's catalog. |
| Config renderer | Reads the base YAML into a generic map, sets the four keys, writes `/data/amdl/config.yaml` with mode 0600 at startup and when the base file changes. | Every other key keeps its value. |
| Runner | `exec.CommandContext` with `SysProcAttr.Setpgid`, a line splitter for `\n` and `\r`, the last 50 lines kept for the error message, the JSON array parsed from the last line that starts with `[`. | sources/apple-music.md. |
| Progress rules | Written against the recorded fixture. Until it exists, progress is the count of tracks in the final JSON, reported at the end. | The output format is only known from a real run. |
| Cancel | SIGTERM to the process group, SIGKILL after 5 seconds. | ffmpeg children stop too. |
| Wrapper client | `internal/modules/applemusic/wrapper` calls the control API with the token and a 10-second timeout. | One place for the protocol. |
| Supervisor | `cmd/shelf-wrapper` in the shelf module, static, no shelf imports beyond a small shared `wrapperapi` package with the request and state types. | The protocol lives in one repo. |
| Base image | `ghcr.io/tikhonp/wrapper-lite@sha256:<digest>`, the digest of today's `latest`, looked up with `docker buildx imagetools inspect`. | Bumped on purpose, never by surprise. |
| Code file | Written to a temp name in `/app/rootfs/data` and renamed to `2fa.txt`, mode 0600. | wrapper-lite never reads half a file. |

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| The token is found in a fixture page and script | `TestTokenScrape` |
| The token is reused until shortly before `exp` | `TestTokenCached` |
| A 401 scrapes again and retries once | `TestTokenRefreshOn401` |
| A 429 backs off, then fails after three tries | `TestBackoffOn429` |
| Search maps albums, songs, artists and playlists, and quality from `audioTraits` | `TestSearchMapsTypes`, `TestQualityFromTraits` |
| A long album pages through its tracks | `TestAlbumPaging` |
| An artist resolves through views, or through `/albums` when views are refused | `TestArtistViews`, `TestArtistFallback` |
| The storefront comes from the wrapper, else from the config | `TestStorefront` |
| Every link form; music videos and stations refused | `TestParseLinkForms`, `TestRefusedLinks` |
| The renderer sets the four keys and keeps the rest; mode 0600 | `TestRenderConfig` |
| A missing or broken base config disables the module with a clear error | `TestMissingBaseConfig` |
| The runner reads `\r` and `\n` lines, progress and the JSON result | `TestRunnerOutput` |
| A non-zero exit fails with the last error lines | `TestRunnerFailure` |
| The timeout kills the run | `TestRunnerTimeout` |
| Cancel kills the whole process group | `TestRunnerCancelKillsGroup` |
| The run gets the working folder and environment | `TestRunnerEnvironment` |
| Service mode restarts with backoff | `TestServiceRestarts` |
| SIGTERM stops wrapper-lite with SIGINT, then SIGKILL | `TestStopSequence` |
| `Enter your 2FA code` moves the state to `awaiting_code` with a deadline | `TestLoginAwaitsCode` |
| A code outside `awaiting_code` answers 409 | `TestCodeOutsideAwaiting` |
| A code is written atomically to the right path | `TestCodeFileWritten` |
| Success starts service mode and reaches `running` | `TestLoginSuccess` |
| A failed sign-in records the auth error line and restarts service mode | `TestLoginFailure` |
| The 60-second timeout line is recorded | `TestLoginCodeTimeout` |
| A second login while one runs answers 409 | `TestLoginWhileRunning` |
| A request without the right token answers 401 | `TestControlNeedsToken` |
| The log keeps 1,000 lines and never shows the password | `TestLogRingRedacts` |
| An empty `regions` list means `signed_out` | `TestStateSignedOut` |

## As built

Built on 2026-11-04, short of its staging run. `make check`, `make lint`, `make web-check` and `docker build .` pass, and both images build: `make build-image` and the new `make build-wrapper-image`.

Local run on an arm64 Mac, with the two images in one compose stack and a copy of the production amdl config without its tokens: wrapper-lite ran under Rosetta in the privileged wrapper container and reported `signed_out`; shelf listed Apple Music as enabled with that health, passed state, log, restart and code requests to the supervisor and back, sent a `source` event when a restart moved the state, and `docker stop` ended the wrapper in under a second with exit 0. The control API refused a missing or wrong token. amdl in the shelf image reports `v0.1.4`.

With the owner's leave, the same stack then called Apple's catalog through shelf, with the storefront from the config since the wrapper was signed out. Search answered all four kinds; an album, a song link with `?i=`, two playlists and an artist resolved. Apple accepted the artist views: Radiohead gave 11 albums, 26 EPs and singles, 3 compilations and 1 appears-on, with views paged by 10 through `next` links that carry `l` and `offset`. Those answers are recorded in `testdata/live`, without Apple's editorial notes, and `TestArtistViewsLive` reads them. `artists/{id}/albums?limit=100` answered too, with 46 albums.

The owner then signed the local wrapper in through `/api/applemusic/wrapper/login` and `/code`, with its own `--device-info`. It reached `running` with storefront `ru` and stayed signed in when its container was recreated. Through shelf, a song link, In Rainbows, Creep - EP, Pablo Honey and a Dolby Atmos single downloaded. They gave FLAC files at 16-bit 44.1 kHz and an `ec-3` `.m4a`, and each download had `shelf.txt`, track paths and quality, and per-song progress in the `downloads` events. A second In Rainbows download ended done with every song skipped, and In Rainbows in Dolby Atmos failed before amdl ran. Pablo Honey's first run failed on song 11 because Apple's key server refused its key. wrapper-lite logged `Invalid CKC error.` and amdl `/key returned code=500`. A retry downloaded the song.

The fixtures in `amdl/testdata/live` hold amdl's output for In Rainbows, run in the shelf container the way the runner runs it: a first run, a second over its own files, and one with `--atmos`. Apple's answer for the album is in `testdata/live`. `TestRecordedRuns` and `TestDownloadRecorded` replay them.

Not done yet:

- The staging run on blackberry: shelf and shelf-wrapper deployed there, and one album downloaded through shelf. The owner asked to leave blackberry alone for now. The fixtures it was to record came from the local run.

What differs from the contract:

- States: `starting` is new, from a start of service mode until it answers. `Restart` and `Login` set their state at once, so the answer shows it.
- Sign-in: the launcher exits 0 however the sign-in ends, so `login complete, exiting` decides. wrapper-lite pads its levels, `[INFO ]`, which the supervisor strips before it looks for `auth error` and the rest; `auth failed` counts too. A code file left from an earlier sign-in is removed first. A restart stops a running sign-in.
- Supervisor: tini is PID 1 in the image, to reap what a SIGKILL orphans. wrapper-lite runs in its own process group, and SIGKILL goes to the group. The poller reads `/status` every second until a new run answers, then every 15 seconds, and wakes when service mode starts again. wrapper-lite's `request: GET /status` lines stay out of the log, and so do the heads of its tokens, which it prints after `dev=` and `music=`.
- Routes: `GET /api/applemusic/wrapper/log?after=` is new, for the Status page's log tail. The supervisor's 4xx answers pass through with their message; a refused token is 502, no answer 503, Apple Music not set up 422. The routes work while the base config is broken, so the Status page can still sign in.
- Health: the module's `Run` reads the supervisor's state every 15 seconds, every 2 while it starts or signs in, and at once after a route. A change publishes a `source` event with `wrapper`.
- Catalog: the script pattern stops at quotes and spaces, `/assets/index~[^/"'\s]+\.js`. A second 401 in a row is an error. The client caps Retry-After at a minute and reads albums with `include=tracks,artists`. Search asks for one type at a time, at most 25, and its total counts one past the items while Apple has more. Artwork is filled at 600x600. The storefront keeps its last value while the wrapper doesn't answer, and asks again after a minute. Views answered without data, or refused with 400 or 403, fall back to `/albums`, split by `isSingle` and `isCompilation`.
- Albums and playlists list songs only; amdl's item numbers, which count music videos, map to the songs' positions. amdl still saves such a video in the release folder. Download refuses a release with no songs, such as a playlist of music videos, before amdl runs, since amdl would save the videos and the download would end done with nothing.
- `SHELF_WRAPPER_LITE_ARGS` takes quotes around a value with spaces, for `--device-info`.
- Config renderer: YAML nodes keep comments and key order, and the renderer adds a missing `general` or `paths`. Init reads and checks the base, and the runner writes the rendered file before a run when the base changed or the file is missing.
- Runner: songs start at `Track N of M`, skips follow `already exists locally`, and failure lines become the song's error. The recorded runs show amdl's bars as `Decrypting...` or `Downloading...` with a percentage and a count, and no bar. Their redraws reach the job log every 5 seconds and at 100%, and their counts become the song's progress at most once a second. A failure printed on a bar's line is split off and always logged. The closing JSON list stays out of the job log, and the runner reads it from the last line that parses. A run that lists no song, or stops before its list, fails the download. A written FLAC file's quality comes from its STREAMINFO block; an `.m4a` file gets the format's codec.
- Failed runs: a run that ends with `Error detected, exiting...` runs once more, and a song the first run wrote counts as done. A second failure, or any other non-zero exit, fails the download without per-song results.
- Dolby Atmos: a release whose songs all lack the `atmos` trait fails before amdl runs, since amdl would fail every song, exit 0, and leave a folder with lyrics and a cover.
- Files beyond the contract's list: `internal/modules/applemusic/download.go`, the `wrapper` client's test, `cmd/shelf-wrapper/supervisor_test.go`, fixtures in `internal/modules/applemusic/testdata`, and the recorded runs in `amdl/testdata/live` in place of `testdata/*.txt`. The module's tests run the test binary as a fake amdl, so it can write real FLAC headers; `amdl/testdata/fake-amdl.sh` serves the runner's own tests.
- Tests beyond the checklist: `TestArtistViewsLive`, `TestSplitArgs`, `TestStateRunning`, `TestLoginWithoutCode`, `TestRestartWakesPoll`, `TestRestartStopsSignIn`, `TestMessage`, `TestErrorLines`, `TestModuleEnabled`, `TestWrapperRoutes`, `TestPasswordNeverLogged`, `TestHealthFollowsWrapper`, `TestDownloadAlbum`, `TestDownloadSong`, `TestDownloadFailure`, `TestMatchSongs`, `TestFlacInfo`, `TestClient`, `TestBar`, `TestSplitBar`, `TestTrackerAgain`, `TestRecordedRuns`, `TestDownloadRecorded`, `TestDownloadRunsAgain`.
